text:
Sam: Heads-up — we just hit GPU allocation limits in us-west1 for batch-embed jobs. Queue is piling up and the cluster-autoscaler isn't spinning up more nodes (pod pending: 120+). Anyone else seeing this?
Elaine: Yep saw the alerts. Looks like the nodepool gpu-pool-west1 is at quota for GPU-type. Cloud quota says 0 GPUs left in that zone.
Mike: FYI cloud provider is returning RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED for a bunch of provisioning calls. Probably not a transient flake.
Sam: OK. Two quick options: 1) failover queued jobs to us-east1 cluster (has spare GPUs but higher p95 latency), or 2) reroute lower-priority batch-embed -> cpu fallback workers with quantized models to keep latency but degrade quality. Thoughts?
Jessie: Can we shard the queue by region? If we move just the oldest 40% of jobs to us-east1 that might avoid cascading backfills. But needs a routed queue migration and maybe temporary hints to the scheduler.
Ranjit: Prefer region failover first for quality. But need a safe plan for stateful uploads and ephemeral storage. Are jobs idempotent?
Sam: Batch-embed ops are idempotent; they read blobs from s3 and write embeddings back. We can re-enqueue to the east region with a metadata tag region=us-east1 and hop the processing until west capacity returns.
Elaine: Implementation detail: add a small router rule in kafka-consumer that checks region_hotlist and will pull from fallback-topic-us-east if west pending > 50 and job_age > 2m. I can prep a patch.
Mike: Autoscaler note: cluster-autoscaler logs show scale-up rejected due to taints+node-template mismatch. gpu-pool-west1 has nodeAffinity for a specific accelerator SKU that cloud doesn't have available in that AZ, so even if quota existed CA can't provision. We should also consider enabling alternative GPU SKUs in nodepool (A100 vs A10G) with tolerant taints.
Sam: Good catch. Can we add alternate-sku nodepool in us-west1 as a quick follow-up? Might take 10–20m to create. In parallel, start draining retryable work to us-east1.
autoscaler-bot: [alert] CA rejected 18 scaleups in the last 5m: insufficient accelerators in-zone, nodeAffinity failure.
Jessie: I'll push the router patch (small feature flag) and a one-off migration script to requeue top X jobs to fallback-topic-us-east. Patch will be available in ~12m.
Ranjit: Cost callout — rerouting to us-east will increase egress costs and p95 by ~80ms. CPU fallback will save GPU spend but may raise token costs because model inference takes longer. We should metric both paths.
Sam: Right. For now do region failover + alternate-sku pool. If provider quota remains flakey we'll enable cpu-fallback for low-priority queues only. Owner: Jessie for queue migration, Mike for nodepool alternate SKU, Elaine to update router flags. I can coordinate with support to request quota bump but don't expect immediate success.
Elaine: Rolling out router patch to canary (k8s/processing-us-west1) now. Command: 
```
kubectl -n processing apply -f kafka-router-patch-canary.yaml
kubectl rollout status deploy/kafka-router-canary
```
Will watch traffic.
Mike: Spinning up nodepool alt-gpu-west1 (taint: gpu=alt:NoSchedule) using smaller SKU template. Cloud request initiated, template created, create-infra job queued. ETA ~18m.
Sam: Good. I'll monitor pending.queue and post updates. If anyone spots retries failing due to region mismatch ping me.
Jessie: Canary is healthy after 1 minute. Moving 100 backlog jobs to fallback-topic-us-east now (script: requeue-region-failover --count 100 --from west).
autoscaler-bot: [info] 100 jobs requeued -> fallback-topic-us-east by Jessie @ 1897654350
Ranjit: Monitoring job success rate and embedding quality. Will flag if error rate >2% compared to baseline.
Sam: Thanks all. Post-mortem action items: add multi-sku nodepool templates to region onboarding, improve queue-router autoswitch thresholds, and add a cost comparison dashboard for region failover vs cpu-fallback.
Jessie: noted and filing follow-up tickets. :thumbsup:
Sam: Closing thread for now — will reopen if situation worsens.
